# GRINDURUS

> Volatility harvesting protocol: GrindURUS strategies, GRAI fund shares, Grinders custodians, Treasury affiliate NFTs, and GRS protocol equity.

Grindurus runs automated market-taking / volatility harvesting grinders across CEX and on-chain terminals (Binance, CoW Protocol, Jupiter, LiFi, and others), with on-chain fund accounting on Solana and EVM chains.

## Products

- [GRAI](https://grindurus.xyz/grai.json): Grinders Artificial Index — passive fund share for GrindURUS strategies
- [GRS](https://grindurus.xyz/grs.json): Grindurus Token — fixed-supply protocol equity and governance (1B max)
- [Treasury NFT](https://grindurus.xyz/treasury.json): GRAI-TREASURY locker NFT — affiliate fee share and claim ownership

## Sites

- [Landing](https://grindurus.xyz/): Product overview

## Token metadata

- [grai.json](https://grindurus.xyz/grai.json): ERC-1046 / Metaplex URI for GRAI
- [grs.json](https://grindurus.xyz/grs.json): ERC-1046 target URI for GRS
- [treasury.json](https://grindurus.xyz/treasury.json): Metadata URI for Treasury locker NFTs
- [logo.png](https://grindurus.xyz/logo.png): Brand image used by token metadata
